name: Maharashtra Industrial Regulatory Ruleset 2026
description: Deterministic legal approval requirements under Maharashtra Industry Facilitation Framework, MAITRI, and Single Window Portal.
disclaimer: Illustrative prototype data. Verify with the competent authority.

approvals.name: Udyam MSME Registration
approvals.authority: District Industries Centre (DIC) / MoMSME
approvals.legal_basis_label: MSMED Act 2006 (Illustrative, verify with the department)

documents.name: Enterprise PAN Card
Promoter Aadhaar / Identity Proof

approvals.reason_template: Required for MSME status as proposed investment of ₹{investment_cr} Cr is within the ₹50 Cr MSME threshold.

approvals.name: GST Registration (State GST & CGST)
approvals.authority: Department of Goods and Services Tax, Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act 2017 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Enterprise PAN Card
Bank Account Statement / Cancelled Cheque
Proof of Business Premises / Lease Agreement

approvals.reason_template: Mandatory tax registration for conducting commercial manufacturing or trading activity in Maharashtra.

approvals.name: Professional Tax Registration (PTEC & PTRC)
approvals.authority: State Tax Department, Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act 1975 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Enterprise PAN Card
Certificate of Incorporation / Partnership Deed

approvals.reason_template: Required because unit engages {employees} employee(s) liable for statutory profession tax deduction.

approvals.name: Provident Fund (EPFO) & ESIC Registration
approvals.authority: Labour Commissionerate / EPFO & ESIC Joint Portal
approvals.legal_basis_label: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1952 & ESI Act 1948 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Enterprise PAN Card
Employee Roll with Aadhaar/UAN records

approvals.reason_template: Required because enterprise workforce of {employees} persons meets the threshold for social security coverage.

approvals.name: Non-Agricultural (NA) Land Permission
approvals.authority: Revenue & Forest Department, Maharashtra / District Collector
approvals.legal_basis_label: Maharashtra Land Revenue Code 1966 Section 44 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Record of Rights (7/12 Extract) or Property Card
Town Planning Zonal Certificate

approvals.reason_template: Required because project is situated outside MIDC industrial area on private land undergoing {stage} development.

approvals.name: Industrial Building Plan Sanction
approvals.authority: MIDC Special Planning Authority / Municipal Corporation
approvals.legal_basis_label: Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning (MRTP) Act 1966 & MIDC DCR (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Scrutiny fee calculated per sq. meter built-up area (Illustrative)

documents.name: Architectural Layout and Structural Stability Drawings
MIDC Allotment Letter / Land Title Deed

approvals.reason_template: Required for construction of new factory structures or civil expansion at {district} location.

approvals.name: Tree Felling / Transit Permission
approvals.authority: Tree Authority, Local Municipal Body / Forest Department
approvals.legal_basis_label: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection and Preservation of Trees Act 1975 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Site Tree Census Plan and Compensatory Plan

approvals.reason_template: Required for site clearance on large development footprint (₹{investment_cr} Cr capital outlay).

approvals.name: Prior Environmental Clearance (EC)
approvals.authority: State Environment Impact Assessment Authority (SEIAA) Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Environment Impact Assessment Notification 2006 & amendments (Illustrative)

documents.name: Environmental Impact Assessment Report & EMP
Approved Terms of Reference (ToR)

approvals.reason_template: Required because unit is in {sector} sector or has capital investment of ₹{investment_cr} Cr requiring Category B appraisal.

approvals.name: Consent to Establish (CTE)
approvals.authority: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB)
approvals.legal_basis_label: Water Act 1974 & Air Act 1981 Section 25 & 21 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Manufacturing Process Flow Diagram & Water Balance
Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP/STP) Design Scheme
Land Ownership / Possession Documents

approvals.reason_template: Mandatory prior to plant construction for {sector} manufacturing with projected discharge/emissions.

approvals.name: Provisional Fire Safety Clearance (Fire NOC)
approvals.authority: Maharashtra Fire Services / MIDC Fire Brigade
approvals.legal_basis_label: Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act 2006 (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Fire premium cess ₹10 per sq. meter built up (Illustrative)

documents.name: Fire Fighting Hydrant & Evacuation Layout Plan
Structural Fire Resistance Certificate

approvals.reason_template: Required for industrial facility with {power_kw} kW power load and combustible raw materials.

approvals.name: Factory Plan Approval
approvals.authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH), Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Factories Act 1948 Section 6 & Maharashtra Factory Rules 1963 (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Plan scrutiny fee based on installed BHP / KW (Illustrative)

documents.name: Factory Layout Plan showing machine spacing, ventilation & exits
Description of Manufacturing Process with hazardous chemical list

approvals.reason_template: Required for manufacturing enterprise engaging {employees} workers with power load {power_kw} kW under Section 2m(i).

approvals.name: Petroleum & Flammables Storage Licence / NOC
approvals.authority: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO) / District Magistrate
approvals.legal_basis_label: Petroleum Rules 2002 & Gas Cylinders Rules 2016 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Chemical Inventory & MSDS Sheets
Explosive Storage Dike & Isolation Distance Drawing

approvals.reason_template: Required due to planned bulk storage of flammable solvents/chemicals in {sector} operations.

approvals.name: Industrial High Tension / Low Tension Electricity Connection
approvals.authority: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL)
approvals.legal_basis_label: Electricity Act 2003 & MERC Regulations (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Security deposit & service connection charges per KW load (Illustrative)

documents.name: Ownership / Lease Agreement of Premises
Single Line Diagram (SLD) approved by Chartered Electrical Safety Engineer

approvals.reason_template: Required for commissioning industrial electrical grid supply of {power_kw} kW.

approvals.name: Industrial Water Supply Connection
approvals.authority: Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC) / Local Municipal Council
approvals.legal_basis_label: MIDC Water Supply Regulations 1973 (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Connection pipeline deposit & meter installation fee (Illustrative)

documents.name: Water Requirement Calculation & Recycled Water Plan
Plot Allotment Order / Water Pipeline Feasibility Map

approvals.reason_template: Required to supply industrial water demand of {water_kld} KLD at project premises.

approvals.name: Boiler Registration & Mountings Certificate
approvals.authority: Directorate of Steam Boilers, Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Boilers Act 1923 Section 7 & Indian Boiler Regulations 1950 (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Inspection & hydraulic test fee based on boiler heating surface (Illustrative)

documents.name: Manufacturer's Certificate (Form II, III, IV) under IBR
Steam Pipeline Layout & Stress Analysis Drawing

approvals.reason_template: Mandatory prior to firing steam boiler or pressure vessel indicated in plant profile.

approvals.name: Lift / Goods Elevator Erection & Operation Licence
approvals.authority: Chief Electrical Inspectorate & Lift Inspection Authority, Energy Dept
approvals.legal_basis_label: Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act 2017 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Manufacturer Test Certificate and Safety Catch Mechanism Drawings

approvals.reason_template: Required for multistory industrial structure with material handling hoists and freight lifts.

approvals.name: Consent to Operate (CTO)
approvals.authority: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB)
approvals.legal_basis_label: Water Act 1974 & Air Act 1981 Section 26 & 21 (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Renewable operating consent fee based on capital investment (Illustrative)

documents.name: Copy of previously granted Consent to Establish (CTE)
ETP/APCD Commissioning Report & Treated Sample Analysis
CA Certificate on Gross Fixed Capital Investment

approvals.reason_template: Mandatory prior to commercial manufacturing to verify environmental safeguards compliance.

approvals.name: Hazardous Waste Management Authorisation
approvals.authority: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB)
approvals.legal_basis_label: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management & Transboundary Movement) Rules 2016 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Membership Certificate of Common Hazardous Waste TSDF (MEPL/MWML)
Dedicated Hazardous Waste Storage Shed Layout with containment

approvals.reason_template: Mandatory because unit generates hazardous chemical residues, spent solvents, or process sludge.

approvals.name: Factory Licence Grant & Registration
approvals.authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH), Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Factories Act 1948 Section 6 & 7 (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Schedule fee based on horsepower and max workforce (Illustrative)

documents.name: Certificate of Stability in Form 1A by Competent Person
Notice of Occupation in Form 2 under Section 7

approvals.reason_template: Required before starting manufacturing operations with {employees} workers.

approvals.name: Final Fire Safety Certificate (Fire NOC)
approvals.authority: Maharashtra Fire Services / MIDC Fire Brigade
approvals.legal_basis_label: Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act 2006 Section 3 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Licensed Agency Installation & Testing Certificate (Form A)
Public Liability / Fire Insurance Policy Cover

approvals.reason_template: Required post-installation of fire hydrants, detectors, and sprinkler system before occupancy.

approvals.name: State Food Safety Manufacturing Licence
approvals.authority: Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Maharashtra / FSSAI
approvals.legal_basis_label: Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 & Regulations 2011 (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: ₹5,000 per annum for State Manufacturing Licence (Illustrative)

documents.name: Food Safety Management System (FSMS) Plan & Recall Procedure
Water Potability Microbiological Test Report
Qualifications & Appointment of Technical Food Chemist

approvals.reason_template: Mandatory statutory licence for processing, packaging, and commercial sale of food items.

approvals.name: Drug & Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Licence
approvals.authority: Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940 & Rules 1945 Form 25/28 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Site Master File as per WHO-GMP Schedule M
Clean Room HVAC Validation & Air Balancing Report
Approved Manufacturing and Analytical Chemist Approvals

approvals.reason_template: Mandatory quality and standards clearance for pharmaceutical active ingredients / formulations.

approvals.name: Packaged Commodities Manufacturer Registration
approvals.authority: Department of Legal Metrology, Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Legal Metrology Act 2009 & Packaged Commodities Rules 2011 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Specimen of Package Label showing MRP, Net Qty, Batch No
Enterprise PAN Card

approvals.reason_template: Required for pre-packaging finished consumer goods with declared net weight or volume.

approvals.name: Principal Employer Registration (Contract Labour)
approvals.authority: Office of the Commissioner of Labour, Maharashtra
approvals.legal_basis_label: Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act 1970 Section 7 (Illustrative)
approvals.fee_label: Sliding scale ₹1,000 to ₹10,000 based on contract workers (Illustrative)

documents.name: Copy of Agreement with Staffing/Security Agencies

approvals.reason_template: Required because workforce scale ({employees} employees) involves deployed outsourced staffing.

approvals.name: Importer-Exporter Code (IEC)
approvals.authority: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) / Industry Facilitation Cell
approvals.legal_basis_label: Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act 1992 (Illustrative)

documents.name: Enterprise PAN Card
Bank Certificate / Cancelled Cheque with preprinted account name

approvals.reason_template: Mandatory foreign trade identifier because enterprise profile indicates international export activities.
